bugs.title: Shadow Clone creation silently stalls mid-copy — likely Worker execution timeout, resulting repo has only .clipforge-sync.json
bugs.notes: Suspected Cloudflare Worker single-request execution time limit exceeded during the sequential bulk file copy (chunks of 4, 2 API calls/file) in createPrivateShadowClone(). Bootstrap commit (.clipforge-sync.json) lands first via Contents API and survives; the rest never completes. Fix: move the long-running bulk copy out of a single Worker invocation (likely into a GitHub Actions workflow dispatched from the Worker, matching existing Stage A/B patterns), preserving the bootstrap-first/default-branch handling logic. Update progress reporting accordingly.

bugs.title: Series Part 2 Stage A still failing — 'release not found' during evidence reuse
bugs.notes: Reuse step now triggers (bug-61 gating fix appears to have landed) but fails: 'release not found', exit code 1. Investigate: (1) verify bug-61's series_source_job_id extraction fix in .github/workflows/stage-a.yml; (2) find which release name/tag the reuse step constructs vs what Part 1's Stage B published (possible wrong job id used — current part's instead of series.source_job_id); (3) check timing race between Part 1 release publication and Part 2 Stage A dispatch.

bugs.title: Remove manual 'push update to clones' trigger — updates to clones must be fully automatic
bugs.notes: Design reversal: remove manual 'Push update to clones' button from Settings; on every push to main on the main account, automatically propagate the update to all connected clones reusing the existing sync/copy logic; preserve the changelog/notification-to-clone-owner behavior; preserve owner-identity gating (main vs clone) for source-of-truth determination.
